about.label: ABOUT ME
about.headline: BIOGRAPHY
about.bio_intro: I'm a Software Engineer in Next.js & TypeScript, building engaging web applications and exploring the frontiers of IoT & robotics. I graduated with a Bachelor of Industrial Technology in Information Technology from King Mongkut's University of Technology North Bangkok (Prachinburi Campus).
about.bio_edu_desc: Bachelor of Industrial Technology in Information Technology, King Mongkut's University of Technology North Bangkok (Prachinburi Campus).
about.bio_exp_desc: Former Robotics Engineering Intern at Wireless Solution Asia and freelance Software Engineer.
about.bio_rec_desc: 2nd Place Award in National Contest of the New Generation (ESP32 Robot Controller).
about.resume_prefix: Want to know more about my experience?

description: Designed and built an end-to-end energy harvesting circuit from Piezo Array, Rectifier, Nanopower Harvester, to Battery Storage
Calibrated MT3608 boost converter and TP4056 charger with LTC3588 for safe 18650 Li-ion charging
Developed C++/Arduino firmware on Arduino UNO R3 to monitor accumulated energy and count steps in real time
Verified standalone 5V 2A power output to power microcontrollers and charge external devices
Freelance development of an IoT equipment borrowing & returning web application
Developed both Frontend and Backend, covering equipment and user management systems
Designed the database schema and UI from scratch to deployment
Developed an ESP32 robot controlled via mobile phone, including movement and gripping commands
Taught and demonstrated robot usage to students
Collaborated on developing a National ID card reader application
Programmed and controlled industrial robots (ABB, KUKA, Yaskawa) for welding-path and pick-and-place tasks via Teach Pendant
Programmed Joint, Linear, and Circular motion paths
Configured Tool, Base, WorkObject, and User Frame along with Gripper and I/O sequences
Designed reusable program templates to accelerate execution in time-limited competitions
